captured_by: F008 P2 Vercel rebuild; header re-derived from live 2026-08-14 (nested-header coverage restoration)
tos_note: Official Vercel documentation retained as a minimal factual excerpt for deterministic offline testing.
trim_method: Removed scripts, navigation, styling, unrelated prose, and six unrelated tables (the live document holds 7 tables; 1 is retained). Removed zero rows and zero cells from inside the extracted Hobby/Pro/Enterprise pricing table. Retained all 8 target data rows and every target cell.
digest_reproducibility_note: sha256_original is NOT reproducible across fetches. The live page is server-rendered with a per-build nonce, so a re-fetch yields a different digest with identical structure. Judge this capture by STRUCTURE against the live document, never by digest; a digest mismatch here is drift, not tampering.
inline_markup_retained:
The three tier header cells are spliced VERBATIM from the live document and keep their nested markup: Hobby
(Included), Pro
(Per month), Enterprise
(Per month). This is load-bearing, not decorative. normspace collapses whitespace but never inserts it, so the space in the profile's required label 'Hobby (Included)' exists ONLY because the adapter maps a
inside a cell to a space. Flattening these cells to 'Hobby (Included)' leaves extraction unchanged against the CURRENT engine while removing the only input in the fixture tree that can detect the loss of that branch, which is why the flattened form is a defect rather than a trim.
inline_markup_stripped: Presentational attributes (class, aria-roledescription) were dropped throughout, and the anchor wrappers the live page puts around the first-column metric labels (for example Sandbox Active CPU) were reduced to their text. These removals are outcome-neutral AND remain outcome-neutral under mutation: the collector has no anchor-specific or attribute-specific branch, so nothing in the engine can distinguish them. Disclosed rather than left silent because an omission that changes what the engine DECIDES is the failure mode this capture already suffered once.
